The corrected Vantorre Group seat count is 280. I replied in the thread on your message in #strategic-pod.

You posted 300 at 09:14 on 1 Jul, then corrected it at 09:19. The 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. 280 is the active production roster as of 1 Jul, and Ruth confirmed it in the channel.

That figure is from 1 Jul. If the deck needs a current number, check it against the live roster.
